description: Delete a file from a knowledge base. For git KBs: commits deletion to managed branch. Forgets associated chunks. Registered calls return a queued job_id/status receipt. Read that exact job with service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal; job.result contains the complete operation result and job.error retains any failure. In-process calls return the complete result synchronously.
embedding_description: Remove a single file from a knowledge base and forget the chunks that were indexed from it. For git-backed KBs the deletion is committed to the managed branch. Use to permanently drop one document you no longer want stored or searchable in that KB.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: File deleted and associated chunks forgotten
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Use browse to verify the file path.
